_comment: Which versions show the unfinished-software warning (docs/design/app-bottom-strip.md). Read by BOTH apps' tests, so the desktop rule (src/gui/bottom_strip.rs wip_shown) and the website's (web/shared/shell.js hosWipShown) are held to one list: every 0.x version and every pre-release of 1.0 shows it, a version neither can read shows it, and a finished release hides it.
